user_query: I need to organize a music event for my company's annual conference. Can you provide me with basic information about a song from Soundcloud? I also want to know the details of the artist and the album it belongs to. Additionally, suggest a radio station that plays similar music.

TaskList.description: Fetch basic information about a specific song from Soundcloud.
Retrieve details about the artist associated with the song from Soundcloud.
Get information about the album to which the song belongs.
Suggest a radio station that plays similar music to the song.
